dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It doesn't need to be anything sophisticated. I just want to enjoy the feeling of having a meal at home. It's quite different from eating out.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Restaurants are convenient and all, and you can always trust that the food's gonna be good.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: But you only get that special cozy feeling when you're eating at home, you know?

choices.text: Yeah, I know what you mean.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Great! Then what are we waiting for?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Right, we'll do some steak, and— Oh, wait... you must have had my Outrider's Champion Steak a million times already.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You know what, it's high time I set myself a new culinary challenge.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: ...Ooh, and I know just the dish — today, I'll try my hand at a Sticky Honey Roast!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Uh... But what if the smoke changes the color of your ceiling...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I was thinking of painting it a new color anyway.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry, I can help with the cooking.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hehe, you're so kind to me.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Get ready for the most delicious meal you've ever eaten! ...Even if it takes me a few hundred times.
